product: Track Unity Gateway skill usage with audit logs and the usage dashboard
tagline: You can now track usage of Unity Gateway Skills, which are in Beta.
what_it_does: You can now track usage of Unity Gateway Skills, which are in Beta. Audit logs record skill list, load, and file fetch events under the aiGatewaySkills service. The Skills tab of the usage dashboard shows downloads, loads, and activity by user.
why_it_matters: Usage records include requester and service details, response status, model token usage and latency, MCP call metadata, and coding agent session metadata.
plain_summary: You can now track usage of Unity Gateway Skills, which are in Beta. Audit logs record skill list, load, and file fetch events under the aiGatewaySkills service.
key_takeaway: You can now track usage of Unity Gateway Skills, which are in Beta.
